title: Malicious code in env-helper-friend (npm)
description: The npm package env-helper-friend version 0.2.0 contains malicious code in its postinstall script that exfiltrates environment variables by encoding them into DNS queries. This exfiltration occurs during npm install, sending truncated environment data to a hardcoded domain or an attacker-controlled domain via the URLLY environment variable. The package is labeled as a test or research artifact but executes this data leakage on any default npm install.
